name: iot-jobs-data
description: IoT Jobs is a service that allows you to define a set of jobs — remote operations that are sent to and executed on one or more devices connected to Amazon Web Services IoT Core.

subcommands.name: describe-job-execution
subcommands.description: Gets details of a job execution.

options.name: --job-id
options.description: The unique identifier assigned to this job when it was created

options.name: --thing-name
options.description: The thing name associated with the device the job execution is running on

options.name: --include-job-document
options.description: Optional.

options.name: --no-include-job-document
options.description: Optional.

options.name: --execution-number
options.description: Optional.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.description: Using the command created with the CreateCommand API, start a command execution on a specific device

options.name: --execution-timeout-seconds
